verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers security (SOC2, HIPAA BAA), data deletion via container tags, and self-hosting options, but nowhere does it state a policy on whether user-ingested content is or isn't used to train Supermemory's or third-party AI models, nor any opt-out mechanism for such training. This is a fair privacy-posture question for an AI memory platform, but no evidence addresses it.
